title: At most three-variable linear constraint evaluation
statement: Let a constraint apply a linear equation over the two-element field to an ordered tuple of distinct variables, with arity at most three, and let an assignment give each variable a value in that field. The constraint evaluation is true exactly when the sum of the assigned values on its scope equals the equation’s right-hand side.
hypotheses_covered: Constraint uses a predicate of arity at most three
Constraint scope is an ordered tuple of distinct variables
Assignment maps variables to the two-element field
